checks.test: Cold entry is New conversation, no empty demo record is created
Repeated New conversation without sending creates no history entries
First send creates one record, duplicate send is locked, next new draft is independent
History remains accessible from the navigation drawer
Tool summaries are borderless rows; command has no command preview
Command opens inline Shell containing the actual fixture command and its output
File edit opens raw-line diff with correct additions/removals and line numbers
Diff uses full conversation width with only local horizontal overflow
Copy Diff copies the patch source, not HTML or line-number labels
Empty command output is explicitly distinct from pending execution
Pending/running/failed/cancelled records are not falsely marked completed
Missing snapshot shows no fabricated diff or change count
Theme rerender preserves tool node, expanded state and horizontal scroll
Down-chevron label/icon centers align within one pixel in light and dark
Provider default changes keep stable DOM nodes for smooth control transitions
Non-navigation rerenders preserve text-field focus and edited value
Inline expansion interpolates real layout height and collapses correctly
Rapid expand/collapse reversals finish in the last requested state
Popup-to-popup replacement animates the old surface out and cleans up
Top banner reserves animated height on entry and releases it on exit
Ordinary state changes have local transitions rather than page re-entry
Width, button, send-state CSS transitions are configured
Reduced-motion renders final states with no web animations
Continuous Markdown token updates never reanimate page or content blocks

environment: Desktop Chromium with 360/412 CSS-pixel viewports. Script-injected standalone HTML (file:// blocked by environment policy). Not Android testing.
